svg.title: Melder ownership and lifetime map
svg.desc: Aetheric frames contain frame-wide unique objects and root conduits. Conduits own scoped objects, lineages may share objects with child conduits, leased spell spaces own request-local objects, and many creates a fresh object per meld. A root conduit keeps one pool per managed_spell_quantity spell version; the pool leases objects to holders, who own them until they release them through ReleaseManagedSpell. Cleanup moves from narrow scopes toward broad owners, and a root disposes its pools' idle objects first.
